as_told.title: Cattle mutilations around the missile field and confiscated camera
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

plain: In 1977 cattle were said to be turning up dead and mutilated around the nuclear missile field near Ellsworth Air Force Base, in the weeks before a night when airmen there report being abducted. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear missile site, says cattle mutilations were going on in the area and that Linda Moulton Howe, a journalist who investigates such cases, was there. Jesse Michels tells it from what an Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson told him: cattle had been dying around the missile field in the weeks before that November night, and a camera was confiscated. The tellers bring it up as a sign that something strange was already happening around the nuclear weapons.
